the Institute for Economics and Peace (IEP),
based in Sydney, Australia.
➤ The GPI evaluates peace across three domains: so-
cietal safety and security, ongoing domestic
and international conflict, and militarisation.
➤ Iceland has zero standing army and exceptionally
low crime rates, consistently placing it at Rank 1.
➤ The index covers 163 independent states and
territories, comprising over 99% of the world's popula-
tion.
➤ Other nations consistently appearing near the top of
the index include Denmark, Ireland, and New
Zealand.
✔ Answer: (D)

त इंस्टी-

क्षा और संरक्षा, चल रहे घरेलू और अंतर्राष्ट्रीीय संघर्ष, और सै-
न्यीकरण।

tariffs.

Right option (B): had implemented
Explanation
Rule: In a mixed or third conditional expressing an un-
real past condition ('if developers...'), the past perfect
tense had implemented is required with the result

subject performing the action.
Therefore, had implemented is the grammatically cor-
rect choice.

16.question_text_hi: Each of these questions is based on the following information: 1. R + T means R is the mother of T. 2. R – T means R is the sister of T. 3. R * T means R is the father of T. 4. R β T means R is the brother of T. Which of the following means that N is the maternal uncle of M?

ter of L; L is mother of E; E is sister of M.

the maternal uncle of M. (The other options do not give a
maternal uncle.)
Answer: N β P - L + E - M

19.question_text_en: A clock gains 5 minutes every hour. If it shows 6:00 AM when the actual time is 5:00 AM, what is the real time when it shows 12:00 PM?
19.question_text_hi: A clock gains 5 minutes every hour. If it shows 6:00 AM when the actual time is 5:00 AM, what is the real time when it shows 12:00 PM?
19.explanation_en:
Q.31
Right option (B): 10:32 AM
Explanation
The clock gains 5 min per hour: 65 clock min = 60 real
min.
Clock time from 6:00 AM to 12:00 PM = 360 min
Real time = 360 × 60/65 = 332 4/13 min ≈ 5 h 32 min
Real time = 5:00 AM + 5:32 ≈ 10:32 AM
Answer: 10:32 AM
✔ Answer: (B)

21.question_text_en: A is as much younger than B as he is older than C. If the sum of ages of A, B, and C is 72 years and B is 8 years older than C, what is A’s present age?
21.question_text_hi: यदि 10 फरवरी 2028 को गुरुवार है, तो 10 फरवरी 2030 को सप्ताह का कौन-सा दिन होगा?
21.explanation_en:
Q.14
Right option (C): 24 years
Explanation
A is as much younger than B as older than C, so A = (B
+ C)/2.
B = C + 8 → A = C + 4
C + (C + 4) + (C + 8) = 72 → 3C = 60 → C = 20
A = 20 + 4 = 24 years
Answer: 24 years
✔ Answer: (C)
21.explanation_hi:
Q.14
Right option (C): रविवार
Explanation
10 फरवरी 2028 से 10 फरवरी 2030 तक:
• 10 फरवरी 2028 से 10 फरवरी 2029 (29 फरवरी 2028 शा-
मिल होने के कारण) = 2 विषम दिन।
• 10 फरवरी 2029 से 10 फरवरी 2030 (साधारण वर्ष) = 1 विषम
दिन।
कुल विषम दिन = 2 + 1 = 3।
अतः 10 फरवरी 2030 = गुरुवार + 3 दिन = रविवार (Sunday)।
✔ Answer: (C)

26.question_text_en: Q.19 Which Sikh festival is celebrated annually in Muktsar to honour the memory of the 'Chalis Mukte' (forty Sikh martyrs) who died fighting against the Mughal emperor Wazir Khan?
26.question_text_hi: Q.19 'चालीस मुक्ते' (चालीस सिख शहीद) जिन्होंोंनेने मुग़ल सूबेदार वज़ीीर ख़ाान के विरुद्ध लड़ते हुए अपने प्राण दिए थे, की स्मृति में मुक्तसर में प्रतिवर्ष कौन-सा सिख त्योहार मनाया जाता है?
26.explanation_en:
Explanation
The festival of Maghi (celebrated on the first day of the
Punjabi month of Magh) is held as Mela Maghi at
Muktsar Sahib to commemorate the bravery of the
Chalis Mukte (Forty Liberated Ones) who laid down
their lives in the Battle of Muktsar (1705).
Important Facts:
➤ The Battle of Khidrana (Muktsar) was fought in
1705 between the Mughal forces under Wazir Khan and
Guru Gobind Singh Ji.
➤ The forty Sikh soldiers who sacrificed their lives were
blessed by Guru Gobind Singh Ji as the Chalis Mukte
(Forty Liberated Ones).
➤ Following their sacrifice, the town of Khidrana was re-
named Sri Muktsar Sahib.
➤ Mai Bhago, a revered Sikh heroine, rallied and led
these forty warriors into the battlefield.
➤ The annual fair, Mela Maghi, is held on the day of
Makar Sankranti / Maghi at Sri Muktsar Sahib in Punjab.
✔ Answer: (D)
26.explanation_hi:

माघी का त्योहार (पंजाबी माह माघ के पहले दिन) मुक्तसर साहिब

युद्ध में शहीद हुए चालीस मुक्तों (40 मुक्त सिख योद्धाओं) के

महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य:
➤ खिदराना (मुक्तसर) का युद्ध 1705 ईस्वी में वजीर खान की
मुगल सेना और गुरु गोबिंंद सिंंह जी के बीच लड़ाा गया था।
➤ युद्ध में बलिदान देने वाले चालीस सिख योद्धाओं को गुरु गोबिंंद
सिंंह जी ने 'चालीस मुक्ते' की उपाधि दी थी।
➤ इन शहीदों के सम्मान में खिदराना का नाम बदलकर श्री मु-
क्तसर साहिब कर दिया गया।
➤ वीर सिख वीरांगना माई भागो ने इन चालीस योद्धाओं को प्रेरित
कर युद्ध के मैदान में नेतृत्व किया था।
➤ पंजाब के श्री मुक्तसर साहिब में मकर संक्रांति (माघी) के पावन
अवसर पर वार्षिक मेला माघी आयोजित किया जाता है।

28.question_text_hi: Q.7 पीएम जन धन योजना का मुख्य उद्देेश्य क्याा है?
28.explanation_en:
Explanation
Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) is a
national mission for comprehensive financial inclu-
sion, launched to ensure that every household across
India has access to basic banking services, savings ac-
counts, credit, remittance, and insurance.
Important Facts:
➤ PMJDY was launched by Prime Minister Narendra
Modi on 28 August 2014 with the slogan *"Mera
Khata, Bhagya Vidhata"*.
➤ The scheme provides basic savings bank deposit
(BSBD) zero-balance accounts to unbanked individuals.
➤ Beneficiaries receive a RuPay debit card with
built-in accidental insurance cover.
➤ An overdraft (OD) facility of up to Rs10,000 is
available to eligible account holders.
➤ PMJDY serves as the foundational pillar for the JAM
(Jan Dhan-Aadhaar-Mobile) Trinity enabling di-
rect benefit transfers (DBT).
✔ Answer: (B)

29.question_text_en: Q.16 The presence of a stepped water tank known as a 'surya-kund' with miniature temples carved on its steps is a unique architectural feature of which temple style?
29.question_text_hi: Q.16 'सूर्य-कुंड' के नाम से ज्ञात एक सीढ़ीीदार जलकुंड, जिसकी सीढ़ियों पर लघु मंदिरों की नक्काशी की गई है, किस मंदिर शैली की अनूठी स्थाापत्य विशेषता है?
29.explanation_en:
Explanation
The stepped water tank called Surya-kund, lined with
numerous miniature shrines along its terraces and steps,
is the hallmark of the Solanki (Maru-Gurjara)
School of architecture, famously seen at the Sun
Temple in Modhera, Gujarat.
Important Facts:
➤ The Sun Temple at Modhera was built in 1026
CE during the reign of King Bhimdev I of the Solanki
dynasty.
➤ The temple complex consists of three main compo-
nents: the sanctum (Gudhamandapa), the assembly
hall (Sabhamandapa), and the stepped reservoir
(Surya-kund).
➤ The Surya-kund contains 108 miniature shrines
dedicated to various deities carved along the stepped
terraces.
➤ The Solanki school belongs to the western Indian
branch of the Nagara architectural order.
➤ The sanctum was designed so that the first rays of
the rising sun fell directly on the deity during equinoxes.
✔ Answer: (C)
29.explanation_hi:
Explanation
सीढ़ियों पर बने कई लघु मंदिरों से युक्त सूर्य-कुंड नामक सीढ़ीीदार
जलाशय सोलंकी (मारु-गुर्जर) स्थापत्य शैली की प्रमुख विशेषता
है, जो मोढेरा (गुजरात) के सूर्य मंदिर में स्पष्ट रूप से दिखाई देती
है।
महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य:
➤ मोढेरा का सूर्य मंदिर सोलंकी वंश के राजा भीमदेव प्रथम के
शासनकाल में 1026 ईस्वी में बनवाया गया था।
➤ मंदिर परिसर में तीन प्रमुख घटक हैं: गर्भगृह (गूढ़मंडप), सभा
मंडप (सभामंडप) और सीढ़ीीदार कुंड (सूर्य-कुंड)।
➤ सूर्य-कुंड की सीढ़ियों और किनारों पर विभिन्न देवी-देवताओं को
समर्पित 108 लघु मंदिर बने हुए हैं।
➤ सोलंकी शैली उत्तर भारतीय नागर शैली की एक महत्वपूर्ण
पश्चिमी उप-शैली है।
➤ इस मंदिर का निर्माण इस तरह किया गया था कि विषुव
(equinox) के दिन उगते सूर्य की पहली किरणें सीधे गर्भगृह पर
पड़ती थीं।
✔ Answer: (C)

30.question_text_en: Q.2 Which three kingdoms emerged in the southern regions of the Subcontinent around 400 BCE?
30.question_text_hi: Q.2 400 ईसा पूर्व के आसपास उपमहाद्वीीप के दक्षिणी क्षेत्रों में किन तीन राज्यों का उदय हुआ?
30.explanation_en:
Explanation
In ancient South India (Tamilakam), the three prominent
early ruling lineages known as the Muventhar (Three
Crowned Kings) were the Cholas, Cheras, and
Pandyas. They emerged during the late Megalithic /
early Sangam period.
Important Facts:
➤ The Sangam literature collectively refers to the
Cholas, Cheras, and Pandyas as the Muventhar
(three crowned kings).
➤ The Cheras ruled over Kerala and western Tamil
Nadu, with their main port at Muziris and capital at
Vanji/Karur.
➤ The Cholas controlled the Kaveri delta and northern
Tamil Nadu, with their capital at Uraiyur and port at

32.question_text_en: Q.7 Which of the following initiatives was explicitly emphasised by Wood's Despatch of 1854?
32.question_text_hi: Q.7 1854 के वुड्स डिस्पैच द्वाारा निम्नलिखित में से किस पहल पर स्पष्ट रूप से बल दिया गया था?
32.explanation_en:
Explanation
Wood's Despatch of 1854, referred to as the
'Magna Carta of English Education in India', placed
strong emphasis on female education, vernacular el-
ementary education, and secular schooling. It also rec-
ommended setting up universities in Calcutta, Bombay,
and Madras.
Important Facts:
➤ Sir Charles Wood, President of the Board of
Control, sent this educational despatch to the Governor-
General Lord Dalhousie in 1854.
➤ It advocated secular education in government-aided
institutions and strongly supported the promotion of
female education.
➤ It recommended the establishment of Universities in
Calcutta, Bombay, and Madras, which were es-
tablished in 1857.
➤ It introduced the Grants-in-Aid system to foster pri-
vate enterprise and voluntary efforts in education.
➤ It recommended vernacular languages as the
medium of instruction at primary levels and English for
higher education.
✔ Answer: (B)

33.question_text_en: Q.9 The objective of price control policies was:
33.question_text_hi: Q.9 मूल्य नियंत्रण नीतियों का उद्देेश्य था:
33.explanation_en:
Explanation
Price control policies (such as ceiling prices or ad-
ministered price mechanisms) are implemented by gov-
ernments primarily to stabilize the market, curb unrea-
sonable price spikes, and prevent inflation on essen-
tial goods and services.
Important Facts:
➤ A price ceiling sets a maximum legal price at
which a good or service can be sold to keep essentials
affordable for consumers.
➤ Government intervention through administered pric-
ing prevents hoarding, speculative price surges, and gal-
loping inflation.
➤ In India, the Essential Commodities Act, 1955
empowers authorities to regulate the supply, distribution,
and pricing of essential commodities.
➤ The Minimum Support Price (MSP) acts as a price
floor designed to protect farmers from sharp declines in
agricultural market prices.
➤ While price ceilings curb inflation, if set below equilib-
rium they can lead to excess demand and shortages in
the open market.
✔ Answer: (A)

35.question_text_en: Q.9 In which Articles of the Indian Constitution is the Right to Equality given?
35.question_text_hi: Q.9 भारतीय संविधान के किन अनुच्छेेदों में समानता का अधिकार दिया गया है?
35.explanation_en:
Explanation
The Right to Equality is enshrined in Articles 14
to 18 under Part III of the Constitution of India, guaran-
teeing equality before the law and prohibiting discrimina-
tion on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, or place of
birth.
Important Facts:
➤ Article 14 guarantees equality before the law and
equal protection of the laws within India.
➤ Article 15 prohibits discrimination on grounds only
of religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth.
➤ Article 16 ensures equality of opportunity in mat-
ters of public employment.
➤ Article 17 abolishes untouchability and forbids
its practice in any form.
➤ Article 18 provides for the abolition of titles, except
military and academic distinctions.
✔ Answer: (B)
35.explanation_hi:
Explanation

36.question_text_en: Q.7 Which Chief Justice of India was known for heading the bench that upheld the abrogation of Article 370 (recent constitutional developments)?
36.question_text_hi: Q.7 भारत के किस मुख्य न्यायाधीश को अनुच्छेेद 370 के निरसन को बरकरार रखने वाली पीठ की अध्यक्षता करने के लिए जाना जाता है?
36.explanation_en:
Explanation
In December 2023, a five-judge Constitution Bench
headed by Chief Justice of India Justice D.Y.
Chandrachud unanimously upheld the validity of the
Government of India's decision to abrogate Article
370 of the Indian Constitution.
Important Facts:
➤ The five-judge Constitution bench was led by the
50th Chief Justice of India, Justice D.Y.
Chandrachud.
➤ The Supreme Court ruled that Article 370 was a
temporary provision introduced in the Constitution.
➤ The verdict held that the State of Jammu and
Kashmir did not retain sovereign status after signing the
Instrument of Accession.
➤ The Court directed the Election Commission of India
to conduct legislative assembly elections in Jammu and
Kashmir.
➤ Article 370 of the Constitution had originally granted
special autonomous status to Jammu and Kashmir
within the Indian Union.
✔ Answer: (A)

37.question_text_en: Q.8 The final authority to interpret the Constitution rests with:
37.question_text_hi: Q.8 संविधान की व्याख्या करने का अंतिम अधिकार किसके पास है?
37.explanation_en:
Explanation
The Supreme Court of India is the ultimate
guardian, protector, and final interpreter of the
Constitution of India. Its interpretation of any consti-
tutional provision is binding on all courts and authorities
throughout the territory of India under Article 141.
Important Facts:
➤ Article 141 of the Constitution states that the law
declared by the Supreme Court shall be binding on all
courts within the territory of India.
➤ Article 132 and 133 provide appellate jurisdiction
to the Supreme Court in constitutional cases involving
substantial questions of law.
➤ The Supreme Court has the power of Judicial
Review to strike down any legislative enactment or ex-
ecutive action violating the Constitution.
➤ In the landmark Kesavananda Bharati case
(1973), the Supreme Court enunciated the Basic
Structure doctrine, limiting Parliament's amending
powers.
➤ The Supreme Court of India was established on 26
January 1950, succeeding the Federal Court of India.
✔ Answer: (D)
37.explanation_hi:
Explanation
भारत का सर्वोच्च न्यायालय (Supreme Court) भारतीय सं-
विधान का अंतिम संरक्षक और एकमात्र आधिकारिक व्याख्या-
कार है। संविधान के किसी भी प्रावधान पर सर्वोच्च न्यायालय द्वाारा
दी गई व्याख्या भारत के सभी न्यायालयों और प्राधिकारियों पर बा-
ध्यकारी होती है।
महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य:
➤ अनुच्छेद 141 के अनुसार सर्वोच्च न्यायालय द्वाारा घोषित कानून
भारत के सभी न्यायालयों के लिए बाध्यकारी होता है।
➤ अनुच्छेद 132 के तहत सर्वोच्च न्यायालय को संविधान की व्या-
ख्या से संबंधित मामलों में अपीलीय क्षेत्राधिकार प्राप्त है।
➤ सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के पास न्यायिक समीक्षा (Judicial
Review) का अधिकार है, जिसके तहत वह संविधान का उल्लंघन
करने वाले किसी भी कानून को असंवैधानिक घोषित कर सकता है।
➤ ऐतिहासिक केशवानंद भारती वाद (1973) में सर्वोच्च न्या-
यालय ने संविधान के 'मूल ढांचे के सिद्धांत' का प्रतिपादन किया
था।
➤ भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय की स्थापना 26 जनवरी 1950 को
हुई थी, जिसने भारत की तत्कालीन संघीय अदालत (Federal
Court) का स्थान लिया था।
✔ Answer: (D)

38.question_text_en: Q.12 Which factor is responsible for the apparent shift of constellations visible in the night sky over different seasons of the year?
38.question_text_hi: Q.12 वर्ष की विभिन्न ऋतुओं में रात्रि के आकाश में दिखाई देने वाले नक्षत्रों के आभासी परिवर्तन के लिए कौन-सा कारक उत्तरदायी है?

options.text_hi: सूर्य के चारों ओर पृथ्वीी का परिक्रमण

38.explanation_en:
Explanation
As the Earth undergoes revolution around the Sun
along its orbit, the night side of the Earth faces in differ-
ent directions in space over the course of a year.
Consequently, different constellations appear visible dur-
ing different seasons.
Important Facts:
➤ Earth's revolution takes approximately 365.25
days to complete one orbit around the Sun.
➤ The daily rising and setting of stars across the sky
from east to west is caused by Earth's rotation on its
axis.
➤ The seasonal variation of constellations visible at
midnight occurs because the Earth's night face looks out
toward different celestial coordinates as it revolves.
➤ Constellations visible only at particular times of the
year are termed seasonal constellations (e.g.,
Orion in winter, Scorpius in summer).
➤ Constellations located close to celestial poles that re-
main visible year-round from high latitudes are known as
circumpolar constellations.
✔ Answer: (B)
38.explanation_hi:
Explanation
जैसे-जैसे पृथ्वीी अपनी कक्षा में सूर्य के चारों ओर परिक्रमण करती
है, वर्ष भर अंतरिक्ष में पृथ्वीी के रात्रि वाले हिस्सेे की दिशा बदलती
रहती है। इसी कारण विभिन्न ऋतुओं में रात्रि के आकाश में अलग-
अलग नक्षत्र दिखाई देते हैं।
महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य:
➤ पृथ्वीी का परिक्रमण काल सूर्य के चारों ओर एक चक्कर पूरा
करने में लगभग 365.25 दिन का होता है।
➤ पूर्व से पश्चिम की ओर तारों का दैनिक उदय और अस्त होना पृ-
थ्वीी के अपनी धुरी पर घूर्णन (Rotation) के कारण होता है।
➤ ऋतुओं के साथ मध्यरात्रि में दिखाई देने वाले नक्षत्रों का बदलना
पृथ्वीी की सूर्य के चारों ओर परिक्रमा (Revolution) का प्रत्यक्ष
परिणाम है।
➤ वर्ष के विशेष मौसमों में दिखने वाले नक्षत्रों को मौसमी नक्षत्र
कहा जाता है (जैसे सर्दियों में ओरियन/मृगशीर्ष, गर्मियों में वृश्चिक)।
➤ ध्रुवों के समीप स्थि
त ऐसे नक्षत्र जो वर्ष भर दिखाई देते हैं, उन्हें
ध्रुव-परिक्रामी नक्षत्र (circumpolar constellations)
कहा जाता है।
✔ Answer: (B)

39.question_text_en: Q.4 Avalanches are most likely to occur when?
39.question_text_hi: Q.4 हिमस्खलन (Avalanches) होने की सर्वाधिक संभावना कब होती है?

options.text_en: The snow begins to melt rapidly on slopes
options.text_hi: जब ढलानों पर बर्फ तेजी से पिघलने लगती है

options.text_en: The glaciers slowly move downhill over time
options.text_hi: जब हिमनद समय के साथ धीरे-धीरे नीचे की ओर खिसकते हैं

options.text_en: The rivers overflow due to seasonal rainfall
options.text_hi: जब मौसमी वर्षा के कारण नदियाँ उफान पर होती हैं

options.text_en: The rocks erode gradually along riverbanks
options.text_hi: जब नदी तटों पर चट्टानें धीरे-धीरे अपरदित होती हैं

39.explanation_en:
Explanation
An avalanche occurs when a mass of snow, ice, and
debris suddenly detaches and slides rapidly down a
mountain slope. Rapid warming or melting weakens the
structural bond between snow layers and lubricates the
surface underneath, triggering sudden slides.
Important Facts:
➤ Avalanches are rapid downward movements of
snowpacks triggered on steep slopes, generally between
30° and 45°.
➤ Sudden rises in temperature or rapid snowmelt
destabilize the cohesive forces within the snowpack.
➤ The presence of weak structural layers, such as hoar-
frost or loose granular snow beneath fresh heavy snow,
increases avalanche risk.
➤ High wind speeds and seismic tremors are other nat-
ural factors contributing to avalanche initiation.
➤ In India, snow avalanches frequently occur in high-al-
titude Himalayan regions of Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh,
Himachal Pradesh, and Uttarakhand.
✔ Answer: (A)

Explanation
The Jarawa and Sentinelese are indigenous hunter-
gatherer communities residing in the Andaman and
Nicobar Islands. They are classified as Particularly
Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) of Negrito heritage.
Important Facts:
➤ The Andaman and Nicobar Islands are home

Middle Andaman islands.

Shompen are officially recognized as Particularly
Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs).
➤ The Ministry of Tribal Affairs recognizes 75 PVTGs
across 18 states and the Union Territory of Andaman
and Nicobar Islands.
✔ Answer: (A)

41.question_text_en: Q.12 Any land left uncultivated for a period of more than five years is classified as:
41.question_text_hi: Q.12 पांच वर्ष से अधिक की अवधि के लिए परती (बिना जुताई के) छोड़ीी गई किसी भी भूमि को किस रूप में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है?
41.explanation_en:
Explanation
According to land-use classification in India, land that is
available for cultivation but has been left uncultivated for
more than five successive years is termed as
Culturable Wasteland. It can be brought under culti-
vation through reclamation efforts.
Important Facts:
➤ Current Fallow represents land that is left unculti-
vated for one agricultural year or less.
➤ Fallow other than current fallow refers to
cropland left uncultivated for between one and five
years.
➤ Culturable Wasteland includes land lying fallow
for more than five consecutive years, which can
be cultivated after reclamation.
➤ Barren and Unculturable Land includes land
that cannot be cultivated with available technology (e.g.,
steep mountains, deserts, rocky outcrops).
➤ Land use statistics in India are systematically com-
piled by the Directorate of Economics and Statistics un-
der nine standard categories.
✔ Answer: (B)
41.explanation_hi:
Explanation
भारत में भूमि उपयोग वर्गीकरण के अनुसार, वह भूमि जो खेती यो-
ग्य है परंतु पांच वर्ष से अधिक समय से बिना जुताई के परती पड़ीी
है, उसे कृषि योग्य बंजर भूमि (Culturable Wasteland)
कहा जाता है। सुधार के बाद इसे पुनः खेती के उपयोग में लाया जा
सकता है।
महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य:
➤ वर्तमान परती (Current Fallow) वह भूमि है जो एक
कृषि वर्ष या उससे कम समय के लिए खाली छोड़ीी जाती है।
➤ पुरातन परती (Fallow other than current
fallow) वह भूमि है जो एक से पांच वर्ष की अवधि तक बिना जु-
ताई के रहती है।
➤ कृषि योग्य बंजर भूमि वह होती है जो पांच वर्ष से अधिक
समय से परती पड़ीी हो और भूमि सुधार द्वाारा पुनः कृषि योग्य बनाई
जा सकती हो।
➤ बंजर और अकृषि योग्य भूमि ऐसी भूमि है जिसे उपलब्ध तक-
नीक से जोता नहीं जा सकता (जैसे रेतीले मरुस्थल, चट्टानी पहाड़)।
➤ भारत में भूमि उपयोग के आंकड़ेे अर्थशास्त्र एवं सांख्यि
की निदे-
शालय द्वाारा नौ मानक श्रेणियों में संकलित किए जाते हैं।
✔ Answer: (B)

43.question_text_en: Q.9 If India fails to provide education and employment to its growing working-age population, what will happen to the demographic dividend?
43.question_text_hi: Q.9 यदि भारत अपनी बढ़ती कामकाजी उम्र की आबादी को शिक्षा और रोजगार प्रदान करने में विफल रहता है, तो जनसांख्यि कीय लाभांश का क्याा होगा?

options.text_en: It will convert into a demographic burden.
It will reduce the dependency ratio further.

options.text_hi: यह निर्भरता अनुपात को और कम करेगा।

43.explanation_en:
Explanation
A demographic dividend yields economic prosperity only
when the working-age population is educated, skilled,
and gainfully employed. Without adequate schooling,
health, and jobs, high numbers of unemployed youth
turn the potential dividend into a demographic bur-
den / disaster.
Important Facts:
➤ The demographic dividend refers to the eco-
nomic growth potential resulting from shifts in a
population’s age structure, specifically when the work-
ing-age share is larger.
➤ The working-age population is universally defined as
individuals aged 15 to 64 years (or 15–59 years).
➤ The dependency ratio measures the proportion of
dependents (children and elderly) relative to the working-
age population.
➤ Failure to generate productive jobs leads to youth un-
deremployment, social instability, and increased fiscal
pressure on public finances.
➤ India's demographic window of opportunity opened
around 2005-06 and is projected to last until roughly the
mid-2050s.
✔ Answer: (B)

वाओं को गुणवत्तापूर्ण शिक्षा और रोजगार नहीं मिलता, तो यही अप्र-
युक्त श्रमशक्ति

बोझ (Demographic burden) बन जाती है।
महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य:
➤ जनसांख्यि
कीय लाभांश (Demographic Dividend)
का आशय जनसंख्या की आयु संरचना में परिवर्तन से उत्पन्न होने
वाले आर्थिक विकास के अवसर से है।
➤ कार्यशील जनसंख्या को आमतौर पर 15 से 64 वर्ष (या 15–
59 वर्ष) आयु वर्ग के रूप में परिभाषित किया जाता है।
➤ निर्भरता अनुपात (Dependency Ratio) कार्यशील आयु
वर्ग पर निर्भर बच्चों और वृद्धों के अनुपात को दर्शाता है।
➤ रोजगार सृजन और कौशल विकास के अभाव में लाभांश बेरोज-
गारी और आर्थिक असमानता में तब्दील हो जाता है।
➤ भारत में जनसांख्यि
कीय लाभांश का यह महत्वपूर्ण अवसर
2005-06 से शुरू होकर लगभग 2055 तक प्रभावी रहने का अनु-
मान है।
✔ Answer: (B)

44.question_text_en: Q.5 Which species was the focus of the first complete mitochondrial genome analysis in India?
44.question_text_hi: Q.5 भारत में पहले पूर्ण माइटोकॉन्ड्रियल जीनोम विश्लेेषण का केंद्र कौन-सी प्रजाति थी?
44.explanation_en:
Explanation
Researchers in India successfully sequenced and ana-
lyzed the complete mitochondrial genome (mi-
togenome) of the Madras Hedgehog
(*Paraechinus nudiventris*), uncovering key evolutionary
divergence details and genetic insights for this lesser-
known insectivorous mammal.
Important Facts:
➤ The Madras Hedgehog (*Paraechinus nudiven-
tris*) is a small nocturnal mammal native to the dry
scrublands and grasslands of southern India.
➤ The circular mitochondrial genome of the Madras
Hedgehog was assembled to a length of approximately
17,232 base pairs.
➤ The study identified 13 protein-coding genes, 22
transfer RNAs (tRNAs), and two ribosomal RNAs
(rRNAs) characteristic of vertebrate mitogenomes.
➤ The Madras Hedgehog curls into a spiny ball as a pri-
mary natural defense mechanism against predators.
➤ The species is listed under Schedule II of the Wildlife
(Protection) Act, 1972 in India.
✔ Answer: (B)
44.explanation_hi:
Explanation
भारतीय शोधकर्ताओं ने पहली बार मद्रास हेजहॉग
(*Paraechinus nudiventris*) का संपूर्ण माइटोकॉन्ड्
रियल जी-
नोम अनुक्रमित और विश्लेेषित किया, जिससे इस अल्पज्ञात स्तन-
पायी के विकासवादी इतिहास और आनुवंशिक विशेषताओं की नई
जानकारी प्राप्त हुई।
महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य:
➤ मद्रास हेजहॉग (*Paraechinus nudiventris*) दक्षिण भारत
के शुष्क झाड़ीीदार जंगलों में पाया जाने वाला एक छोटा निशाचर
स्तनपायी है।
➤ मद्रास हेजहॉग के माइटोकॉन्ड्रियल जीनोम की लंबाई लगभग
17,232 बेस पेयर निर्धारित की गई।
➤ इस अध्ययन में कशेरुकी जीवों के सामान्य माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया के
अनुरूप 13 प्रोटीन-कोडिंंग जीन और 22 टी-आरएनए की पहचान
की गई।
➤ शिकारियों से बचाव के लिए यह जीव गेंद की तरह गोल होकर
अपने नुकीले कांटों को बाहर कर लेता है।
➤ भारत में इस प्रजाति को वन्यजीव (संरक्षण) अधिनियम, 1972
की अनुसूची II के तहत कानूनी सुरक्षा प्राप्त है।
✔ Answer: (B)

45.question_text_en: Q.6 Which taxonomic category is used for plants instead of 'Phylum' used for animals?
45.question_text_hi: Q.6 जंतुओं के लिए प्रयुक्त 'फाइलम' (संघ) के स्थाान पर पादपों के लिए किस वर्गीकरण श्रेणी का उपयोग किया जाता है?
45.explanation_en:
Explanation
In biological classification, while animals are grouped
into different Phyla (singular: Phylum) below the
Kingdom level, plants and fungi are historically orga-
nized into equivalent taxonomic categories known as
Divisions.
Important Facts:
➤ The hierarchical taxonomic levels from highest to low-
est are: Kingdom → Phylum/Division → Class →
Order → Family → Genus → Species.
➤ The International Code of Nomenclature for algae,
fungi, and plants (ICN) permits the use of Division syn-
onymously with Phylum.
➤ Plant division names typically end with the standard
suffix -phyta (e.g., Bryophyta, Pteridophyta,
Magnoliophyta).
➤ Carl Linnaeus laid the foundation of modern bio-
logical taxonomy and the binomial nomenclature system
in his work *Systema Naturae*.
➤ Species is the basic and lowest fundamental unit of
biological classification.
✔ Answer: (C)
45.explanation_hi:
Explanation
जैविक वर्गीकरण में, जहां जगत (Kingdom) के नीचे जंतुओं को वि-
भिन्न संघ (Phylum) में विभाजित किया जाता है, वहीं पादपों (पौ-
धों) के वर्गीकरण में संघ के समकक्ष श्रेणी को प्रभाग (Division)
कहा जाता है।
महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य:
➤ जैविक वर्गीकरण का पदानुक्रम है: जगत (Kingdom) →
संघ/प्रभाग (Phylum/Division) → वर्ग (Class) → गण
(Order) → कुल (Family) → वंश (Genus) → जाति
(Species)।
➤ पादपों के लिए प्रभाग (Division) शब्द का उपयोग अंतरराष्ट्रीीय
वनस्पति नामकरण संहिता द्वाारा स्वीकृत है।
➤ पादप प्रभागों के वैज्ञानिक नाम के अंत में सामान्यतः -phyta
प्रत्यय जोड़ाा जाता है (जैसे ब्रायोफाइटा, टेरिडोफाइटा)।
➤ आधुनिक वर्गीकरण विज्ञान और द्विनाम पद्धति का जनक कार्ल
लिनिअस को माना जाता है।
➤ जाति (Species) जैविक वर्गीकरण की सबसे मूलभूत और
प्राथमिक इकाई है।
✔ Answer: (C)

46.question_text_en: Q.2 Which nutrient is primarily responsible for muscle repair?
46.question_text_hi: Q.2 मांसपेशियों की मरम्मत के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन-सा पोषक तत्व उत्तरदायी है?
46.explanation_en:
Explanation
Proteins are the body's building blocks, composed of
amino acids required for the synthesis of cellular struc-
tures, tissue growth, and the repair of damaged
muscles.
Important Facts:
➤ Proteins are polymers made up of amino acids
linked together by peptide bonds.
➤ Nine out of twenty amino acids are considered es-
sential amino acids because the human body can-
not synthesize them internally.
➤ Structural proteins such as actin and myosin form
the contractile components of muscle fibres.
➤ Severe protein deficiency in infants and children
causes deficiency diseases such as Kwashiorkor and
Marasmus.
➤ Dietary sources rich in proteins include pulses, eggs,
milk, fish, soybeans, and lean meats.
✔ Answer: (B)

48.question_text_en: Q.21 How many districts have been identified under Prime Minister Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana (DDKY)?
48.question_text_hi: Q.21 प्रधानमंत्री धन-धान्य कृषि योजना (DDKY) के तहत कितने जिलों की पहचान की गई है?
48.explanation_en:
Explanation
Under the Prime Minister Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi
Yojana (PM-DDKY), 100 aspirational agricul-
tural districts have been identified across the country
with low productivity, low cropping intensity, and lower
credit parameters to boost agricultural performance.
Important Facts:
➤ PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana (PM-DDKY)
covers 100 districts across Indian states and union
territories.
➤ The districts were chosen based on low crop
yield/productivity, low cropping intensity, and low institu-
tional credit access.
➤ At least one district has been included from each
state to ensure balanced regional agricultural transfor-
mation.
➤ The initiative aims to converge schemes across agri-
culture and allied sectors to augment farm income and
local storage.
➤ Progress across the 100 districts is tracked through a
dedicated monitoring framework on the lines of the
Aspirational Districts Programme.
✔ Answer: (C)
48.explanation_hi:
Explanation
प्रधानमंत्री धन-धान्य कृषि योजना (PM-DDKY) के अंतर्गत
देश भर में कम उत्पादकता, कम फसल सघनता और कम संस्थागत
ऋण पहुंच वाले 100 आकांक्षी कृषि जिलों की पहचान की गई है
ताकि कृषि प्रदर्शन में सुधार लाया जा सके।
महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य:
➤ प्रधानमंत्री धन-धान्य कृषि योजना के तहत देश के राज्यों और
केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों में 100 जिलों को शामिल किया गया है।
➤ इन 100 जिलों का चयन कम फसल उत्पादकता, कम फसल
सघनता और कम कृषि ऋण वितरण के आधार पर किया गया है।
➤ संतुलित क्षेत्रीय विकास सुनिश्चित करने के लिए प्रत्येक राज्य से
कम से कम एक जिले का चयन अनिवार्य रूप से किया गया है।
➤ इस योजना का मुख्य उद्देश्य मौजूदा योजनाओं के समन्वय से
किसानों की आय और फसल कटाई उपरांत भंडारण सुविधाओं को
बढ़ााना है।
➤ इन जिलों की प्रगति की समीक्षा आकांक्षी जिला कार्यक्रम की
तर्ज पर एक विशेष डैशबोर्ड के माध्यम से की जाती है।
✔ Answer: (C)

17.question_text_en: A faulty clock loses 10 minutes every hour. It was set correct at 12 noon. When the clock shows 3:00 PM, what is the actual time?
17.question_text_hi: A faulty clock loses 10 minutes every hour. It was set correct at 12 noon. When the clock shows 3:00 PM, what is the actual time?
17.explanation_en:
Q.35
Right option (C): 3:36 PM
Explanation
The clock loses 10 minutes every hour, so 50 minutes on
the faulty clock equal 60 minutes of actual time (ratio = 5
: 6).
From 12 noon to 3:00 PM on the faulty clock = 3 hours =
180 clock minutes.
Actual time elapsed = 180 × (6 / 5) = 216 minutes = 3
hours 36 minutes.
Therefore, the actual time is 3:36 PM.
✔ Answer: (C)

the worker's monthly contribution.

(LIC).

22.question_text_en: Q.11 The Chaturmukha Shiva Linga, developed prominently during the Kushana period, is associated with which school of Indian sculpture?
22.question_text_hi: Q.11 कुषाण काल के दौरान प्रमुखता से विकसित चतुर्मुख शिव लिंंग, भारतीय मूर्तिकला की किस शैली से संबंधित है?
22.explanation_en:
Explanation
The Chaturmukha Shiva Linga (four-faced Linga)
emerged and flourished under the Mathura school of
sculpture during the Kushana era. Mathura sculptors
were pioneers in creating iconic anthropomorphic forms
of Brahmanical deities alongside Buddhist imagery.
Important Facts:
➤ The Mathura school of art predominantly used
local spotted red sandstone.
➤ It flourished along the banks of the Yamuna River in
Uttar Pradesh from the 1st century BCE to the Gupta pe-
riod.
➤ Mathura art simultaneously produced images of
Buddhism, Jainism, and Hinduism.
➤ The four faces on the Chaturmukha Linga symbolize
the cosmic aspects: Tatpurusha, Aghora,
Vamadeva, and Sadyojata.
➤ Kanishka I was the most famous patron ruler of the
Kushana dynasty.
✔ Answer: (B)

23.question_text_en: Q.8 Which prominent nationalist leader revived the public celebration of Ganesh Chaturthi in 1893, using the festival to promote unity, build nationalistic fervor and circumvent the British ban on public gatherings?
23.question_text_hi: Q.8 किस प्रमुख राष्ट्रवादी नेता ने 1893 में गणेश चतुर्थी के सार्वजनिक उत्सव को पुनर्जीवित किया, और इस त्योहार का उपयोग एकता को बढ़ाावा देने, राष्ट्रवादी भावना जगाने तथा सार्वजनिक सभाओं पर ब्रिटिश प्रतिबंध को विफल करने के लिए किया?
23.explanation_en:
Explanation
Bal Gangadhar Tilak transformed the private do-
mestic worship of Ganesh Chaturthi into a public
festival (Sarvajanik Ganeshotsav) in 1893 to
bridge caste divides and mobilize collective opposition
against colonial British rule.
Important Facts:
➤ Bal Gangadhar Tilak introduced the Shivaji
Festival in 1895 for the same nationalist objective.
➤ He was conferred the popular title "Lokmanya",
meaning accepted by the people.
➤ Tilak published two influential newspapers: Kesari
(in Marathi) and The Mahratta (in English).
➤ He gave the famous slogan: "Swaraj is my
birthright and I shall have it."
➤ British journalist Valentine Chirol termed Tilak as the
"Father of Indian Unrest".
✔ Answer: (C)

24.question_text_en: Q.7 The sector primarily driving India's GDP growth in the post-1991 reform period:
24.question_text_hi: Q.7 1991 के सुधार के बाद की अवधि में भारत की जीडीपी वृद्धि को मुख्य रूप से संचालित करने वाला क्षेत्र:
24.explanation_en:
Explanation
Following the economic reforms of 1991, the service
sector (tertiary sector) expanded rapidly, contribut-
ing more than 50% of India's GDP and becoming the
primary engine of India's economic growth.
Important Facts:
➤ The economic reforms were initiated in July 1991
under the LPG model (Liberalisation,
Privatisation, and Globalisation).
➤ Dr. Manmohan Singh served as the Finance
Minister and P.V. Narasimha Rao was the Prime
Minister in 1991.
➤ Telecommunications, IT/software services, banking,
and financial services spearheaded the service sector
boom.
➤ India skipped the traditional transition from agriculture
directly to large-scale manufacturing, moving straight to-
ward a service-led economy.
➤ The tertiary sector continues to be the largest contrib-
utor to India's Gross Value Added (GVA).
✔ Answer: (C)

25.question_text_en: Q.11 Which of the following correctly states the target and actual growth rates of India's Sixth Five-Year Plan (1980- 1985)?
25.question_text_hi: Q.11 निम्नलिखित में से कौन भारत की छठी पंचवर्षीय योजना (1980- 1985) की लक्षित और वास्तविक विकास दर को सही ढंग से दर्शाता है?
25.explanation_en:
Explanation
The Sixth Five-Year Plan (1980–1985) had set a
target GDP growth rate of 5.2%, against which it
achieved an actual growth rate of 5.7% (often recorded
as 5.66%), marking it as a highly successful plan.
Important Facts:
➤ The Sixth Plan adopted the direct attack on poverty
through programmes like IRDP (Integrated Rural
Development Programme).
➤ It marked the end of Nehruvian socialism principles,
initiating early economic liberalisation.
➤ NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural
Development) was established during this plan in 1982.
➤ The EXIM Bank of India was also established in
1982 during the Sixth Plan.
➤ Family planning programmes were aggressively pro-
moted to stabilize population growth.
✔ Answer: (C)
25.explanation_hi:
Explanation
छठी पंचवर्षीय योजना (1980-1985) में लक्षित जीडीपी वि-
कास दर 5.2% निर्धारित की गई थी, जिसके मुकाबले वास्तविक
विकास दर 5.7% प्राप्त हुई, जिससे यह एक अत्यधिक सफल यो-
जना साबित हुई।
महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य:
➤ छठी योजना में IRDP (एकीकृत ग्रामीण विकास कार्यक्रम) जैसे
कार्यक्रमों के माध्यम से गरीबी पर सीधा प्रहार किया गया।
➤ इसने नेहरूवादी समाजवाद के दौर के अंत और प्रारंभिक
आर्थिक उदारीकरण की शुरुआत को चिह्नित किया।
➤ इस योजना के दौरान 1982 में नाबार्ड (NABARD) की स्था-

26.question_text_en: Q.10 Which Articles of the Indian Constitution are related to the "Right to Freedom"?
26.question_text_hi: Q.10 भारतीय संविधान के कौन से अनुच्छेेद "स्वतंत्रता के अधिकार" से संबंधित हैं?
26.explanation_en:
Explanation
The Right to Freedom is guaranteed under Articles
19 to 22 in Part III of the Constitution of India, covering
basic civil liberties, protection against arbitrary arrest,
and the fundamental right to life.
Important Facts:
➤ Article 19 guarantees six democratic free-
doms (speech, assembly, association, movement, resi-
dence, and profession).
➤ Article 20 provides protection in respect of convic-
tion for offences (against ex-post-facto law, double jeop-
ardy, and self-incrimination).
➤ Article 21 guarantees the Protection of Life
and Personal Liberty.
➤ Article 21A makes free and compulsory education
for children aged 6 to 14 a Fundamental Right (added by
the 86th Amendment Act, 2002).
➤ Article 22 provides protection against arrest and
detention in certain cases.

Amendment Act, 2002.

not be enforced directly through writ petitions.

"Mini-Constitution" due to its sweeping structural
changes.

pellate jurisdiction lies to the Supreme Court from any

proceedings, provided the High Court certifies it involves

Supreme Court in criminal matters.
➤ Article 136 provides for Special Leave to
Appeal (SLP) granted at the discretion of the Supreme
Court.
➤ The Supreme Court of India was officially established
on 28 January 1950.

implementation of the Sixth Schedule.

Eclipses occur when the Sun, Earth, and Moon
align in a straight line (known as syzygy). A solar
eclipse happens when the Moon comes between the
Sun and Earth, while a lunar eclipse occurs when the
Earth comes between the Sun and Moon, casting shad-
ows.
Important Facts:
➤ The straight-line configuration of three celestial bod-
ies in a gravitational system is termed syzygy.
➤ A solar eclipse occurs on a New Moon day
(Amavasya).
➤ A lunar eclipse occurs on a Full Moon night
(Purnima).

31.question_text_en: Q.14 Which movement of the Earth is responsible for the occurrence of one complete year and influences seasonal cycles globally?
31.question_text_hi: Q.14 पृथ्वीी की कौन सी गति एक पूर्ण वर्ष के घटित होने के लिए उत्तरदायी है और विश्व स्तर पर ऋतु चक्र को प्रभावित करती है?
31.explanation_en:
Explanation
The revolution of the Earth around the Sun in
an elliptical orbit takes approximately 365.25 days,
defining one calendar year. Along with the Earth's tilted
axis of 23.5 degrees, revolution is directly responsible for
the cycle of seasons.
Important Facts:
➤ Earth takes 365 days, 5 hours, 48 minutes,
and 46 seconds to complete one revolution.
➤ The rotation of the Earth on its axis causes day and
night and takes approximately 24 hours.
➤ Earth's axis of rotation is tilted at an angle of 66.5
degrees to its orbital plane (or 23.5 degrees from
the perpendicular).
➤ Perihelion is the point when Earth is closest to the
Sun (around January 3).
➤ Aphelion is the point when Earth is farthest from
the Sun (around July 4).
✔ Answer: (B)

32.question_text_en: Q.1 What is the main type of rock found in the Deccan Trap region?
32.question_text_hi: Q.1 दक्कन ट्रैैप क्षेत्र में मुख्य रूप से किस प्रकार की चट्टानें पाई जाती हैं?
32.explanation_en:
Explanation
The Deccan Trap is composed predominantly of
basaltic igneous rocks formed by volcanic fissure
eruptions during the late Cretaceous period. Weathering
of these igneous rocks led to the formation of fertile
black cotton soil (Regur).
Important Facts:
➤ The Deccan volcanic province was formed around
65–66 million years ago.
➤ Basalt is an extrusive (volcanic) igneous rock rich in
iron and magnesium.
➤ The Deccan Trap covers major parts of
Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Madhya Pradesh.
➤ Weathering of Deccan basalt generates black soil,
exceptionally suited for cotton cultivation.
➤ The step-like landscape feature of horizontal lava
flows gives it the Scandinavian name "Trap", meaning
stairs.
✔ Answer: (B)

33.question_text_en: Q.10 In the study of human settlements, what type of rural settlement is characterized by a "dispersed" pattern?
33.question_text_hi: Q.10 मानव बस्ति यों के अध्ययन में, किस प्रकार की ग्रामीण बस्ती को "प्रकीर्ण" (बिखरे हुए) पैटर्न द्वाारा पहचाना जाता है?
33.explanation_en:
Explanation
A dispersed settlement pattern (also known as
isolated settlement) consists of isolated huts or scat-
tered hamlets located far apart across hills, valleys, or
agricultural fields rather than clustered together.
Important Facts:
➤ Dispersed settlements are commonly found in rugged
terrains like the Himalayas, Meghalaya, and parts of
Kerala.
➤ Nucleated or clustered settlements are char-
acterized by houses built closely together, common in
fertile alluvial plains.
➤ Linear settlements develop along physical or
transport corridors such as roads, railway lines, rivers, or
canals.
➤ Fragmented terrain and abundant agricultural land re-
quirements encourage the dispersion of dwellings.
➤ Semi-clustered settlements result from the
segregation or fragmentation of a large compact village.
✔ Answer: (A)

Rajasthan, and Jharkhand.

heat-resistant sheets along its basal cleavage planes.

35.question_text_en: Q.2 The process of breakdown of glucose into pyruvate occurs in which part of the cell?
35.question_text_hi: Q.2 ग्लूूकोज के पाइरूवेट में टूटने की प्रक्रि या कोशिका के किस भाग में होती है?
35.explanation_en:
Explanation
The breakdown of glucose into pyruvate occurs during
glycolysis, which takes place in the cytoplasm of
the cell. This metabolic pathway does not require oxygen
and produces a net gain of 2 ATP and 2 NADH mole-
cules.
Important Facts:
➤ Glycolysis is also known as the EMP pathway
(Embden-Meyerhof-Parnas pathway).
➤ In glycolysis, one 6-carbon molecule of glucose is
converted into two 3-carbon molecules of pyruvate.
➤ The Krebs cycle (citric acid cycle) and oxida-
tive phosphorylation take place inside the mitochon-
dria.
➤ Glycolysis is a universal pathway occurring in both
aerobic and anaerobic organisms.
➤ Mitochondria are known as the "powerhouses
of the cell" because the majority of ATP synthesis oc-
curs there.
✔ Answer: (C)

36.question_text_en: Q.33 Which scientific technology allows farmers and scientists to monitor crop conditions, soil moisture and agricultural patterns using satellite data?
36.question_text_hi: Q.33 कौन सी वैज्ञानिक तकनीक किसानों और वैज्ञानिकों को उपग्रह डेटा का उपयोग करके फसल की स्थि ति, मिट्टी की नमी और कृषि पैटर्न की निगरानी करने की अनुमति देती है?
36.explanation_en:
Explanation
Remote sensing technology captures electromag-
netic radiation reflected or emitted from the Earth's sur-
face via satellite and airborne sensors, enabling preci-
sion assessment of crop health, vegetative indices, and
soil moisture levels.
Important Facts:
➤ The Normalized Difference Vegetation
Index (NDVI) is a standard remote sensing index used
to measure plant health.
➤ India's dedicated remote sensing satellite series is
known as the IRS (Indian Remote Sensing) satel-
lite system.
➤ The National Remote Sensing Centre
(NRSC) is situated at Hyderabad under ISRO.
➤ Remote sensing is broadly classified into active re-
mote sensing (uses own energy source like Radar)
and passive remote sensing (uses Sun's reflected
light).
➤ The Government of India utilizes the FASAL project
(Forecasting Agricultural output using Space, Agro-mete-
orology and Land-based observations) for crop
forecasting.
✔ Answer: (B)
36.explanation_hi:
Explanation
सुदूर संवेदन (रिमोट सेंसिंंग) तकनीक उपग्रह और वायुजनित

स्वास्थ्य, वनस्पति सूचकांक और मिट्टी की नमी की सटीक निगरानी
संभव होती है।
महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य:
➤ एनडीवीआई (NDVI - नॉर्मलाइज्ड डिफरेंस वेजिटेशन इं-
डेक्स) पौधों के स्वास्थ्य को मापने के लिए इस्तेमाल किया जाने वाला

named after French botanist Jean-Baptiste Leschenault.
➤ It thrives predominantly in dry scrub, open thorny
forests, and dry deciduous biomes.
➤ The bird is distinguished by its heavy, curved, red-
and-yellow hooked bill and long graduated tail.

भाबर और शिवालिक तलहटी के मैदानों) के घास के मैदानों और
झाड़ियों में देखा गया, जिसने पक्षी प्रेमियों का ध्यान आकर्षित किया।
महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य:
➤ सरकीर मलकोहा कोयल परिवार कुकुलिडे (Cuculidae) से
संबंधित है।
➤ कई अन्य कोयल प्रजातियों के विपरीत, यह गैर-परजीवी है और
अपने बच्चों को पालने के लिए खुद घोंसला बनाती है।
➤ इसका वैज्ञानिक नाम *टैकोकुआ लेश्चेेनॉल्टी (Taccocua
leschenaultii)* है।
➤ यह मुख्य रूप से शुष्क कंटीले वनों, खुले झाड़ीीदार जंगलों
और पर्णपाती क्षेत्रों में पाई जाती है।
➤ यह पक्षी अपनी भारी, मुड़ीी हुई लाल-पीली चोंच और लंबी पूंछ से
पहचानी जाती है।
✔ Answer: (A)

change programs between accredited zoological parks

42.question_text_en: Q.4 Which nation hosted the fourth in-person QUAD Leaders' Summit in September 2024?
42.question_text_hi: Q.4 सितंबर 2024 में चौथे व्यक्ति गत (इन-पर्सन) क्वााड (QUAD) लीडर्स समिट की मेजबानी किस देश ने की थी?

Explanation

hosted by the United States of America (USA) on
September 21, 2024, in Wilmington, Delaware,
presided over by US President Joe Biden.
Important Facts:
➤ The QUAD (Quadrilateral Security Dialogue) com-
prises India, USA, Japan, and Australia.
➤ The 2024 Wilmington Summit issued the historic joint
statement known as the "Wilmington Declaration".
➤ Prime Minister Narendra Modi represented India
at the summit.
➤ The idea of QUAD was first mooted by Japanese
Prime Minister Shinzo Abe in 2007.
➤ India is scheduled to host the subsequent QUAD
Leaders' Summit.
✔ Answer: (D)

➤ 2024 के विल्मिंं
गटन शिखर सम्मेलन में "विल्मिंं
गटन घोषणा-
पत्र" नामक ऐतिहासिक संयुक्त वक्तव्य जारी किया गया।

liters.

21.question_text_en: Q.4 The classic Sanskrit play 'Abhigyan Shakuntalam' was authored by:
21.question_text_hi: Q.4 प्रसिद्ध संस्कृत नाटक 'अभिज्ञान शाकुंतलम्' किसके द्वाारा रचित था?
21.explanation_en:
Explanation
Abhigyan Shakuntalam is a masterpiece Sanskrit
play authored by the classical playwright and poet
Kalidasa. The play dramatises the love story of King
Dushyanta and Shakuntala, adapted from the epic
Mahabharata.
Important Facts:
➤ Kalidasa lived during the Gupta period and is re-
garded as the greatest poet-dramatist of classical
Sanskrit.
➤ His other major plays include Malavikagnimitram
and Vikramorvashiyam.
➤ Kalidasa's celebrated epic poems (Mahakavya) are
Raghuvamsha and Kumarasambhava.
➤ His famous lyrical poems (Khandakavya) are
Meghaduta and Ritusamhara.
➤ *Abhigyan Shakuntalam* was among the earliest
Indian literary works translated into Western languages,
translated by Sir William Jones in 1789.
✔ Answer: (B)

22.question_text_en: Q.14 Who among the following was the first woman to serve as India's Permanent Representative to the United Nations?
22.question_text_hi: Q.14 निम्नलिखित में से कौन संयुक्त राष्ट्र में भारत की स्थाायी प्रतिनिधि के रूप में सेवा देने वाली पहली महिला थीं?
22.explanation_en:
Explanation
Ruchira Kamboj, an Indian Foreign Service (IFS) offi-
cer of the 1987 batch, made history in August 2022 by
becoming the first woman to serve as India's
Permanent Representative to the United
Nations in New York.
Important Facts:
➤ Ruchira Kamboj succeeded T.S. Tirumurti as
India's Permanent Representative to the UN.
➤ She previously served as India's Ambassador to
Bhutan, Ambassador to UNESCO in Paris, and High
Commissioner to South Africa.
➤ Vijaya Lakshmi Pandit was the first woman to be
elected President of the UN General Assembly
in 1953, but was not the Permanent Representative.
➤ The Permanent Mission of India to the UN represents
the country across the UN Secretariat and its various
bodies.
➤ Ruchira Kamboj retired from the Indian Foreign
Service in June 2024 after an illustrious career.
✔ Answer: (B)

➤ इससे पहले उन्होंनेने भूटान में भारत की राजदूत, पेरिस में यूनेस्को

23.question_text_en: Q.15 Before the World Trade Organization was established in 1995, which organization administered multilateral trade agreements?
23.question_text_hi: Q.15 1995 में विश्व व्यापार संगठन (WTO) की स्थाापना से पहले, कौन सा संगठन बहुपक्षीय व्यापार समझौतों का संचालन करता था?

options.text_hi: व्यापार और शुल्क पर सामान्य समझौता (GATT)

23.explanation_en:
Explanation
The General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade
(GATT) governed international multilateral trade rules
from 1948 until it was officially superseded by the World
Trade Organization (WTO) on 1 January 1995
following the Marrakesh Agreement.
Important Facts:
➤ GATT was signed by 23 nations in Geneva in 1947
and came into effect on 1 January 1948.
➤ The WTO was born out of the Uruguay Round of
trade negotiations, which spanned from 1986 to 1994.
➤ Unlike GATT, which was an ad-hoc legal agreement
with no institutional foundation, the WTO is a full-fledged
permanent international organisation.
➤ The WTO encompasses trade in goods (GATT),
trade in services (GATS), and intellectual prop-
erty rights (TRIPS).
➤ The headquarters of the World Trade Organization is
situated in Geneva, Switzerland.
✔ Answer: (C)

24.question_text_en: Q.17 Which element is essential in a "Panchayatana" temple layout?
24.question_text_hi: Q.17 "पंचायतन" मंदिर शैली के लेआउट में कौन सा तत्व अनिवार्य है?
24.explanation_en:
Explanation
A Panchayatana temple style consists of a main
central shrine surrounded by four subsidiary
shrines, making a total of five shrines. The term
originates from the Sanskrit words 'Pancha' (five) and
'Ayatana' (shrine/abode).
Important Facts:
➤ The Panchayatana layout is a prominent feature
of ancient and medieval Nagara and Dravida archi-
tecture.
➤ Famous examples include the Kandariya
Mahadeva Temple and Lakshmana Temple at
Khajuraho.
➤ In Odisha, the Brahmeshwara Temple in
Bhubaneswar is built on the Panchayatana plan.
➤ The subsidiary shrines are typically placed at the four
corners of a raised rectangular plinth (jagati).
➤ The layout symbolises a central presiding deity
flanked by four complementary secondary deities.
✔ Answer: (B)

Institute (ISI) in Kolkata in 1931.
➤ National Statistics Day is celebrated every year in
India on 29 June to mark the birth anniversary of P.C.
Mahalanobis.
➤ The Second Plan aimed at a rapid 25% increase in
national income through rapid industrialisation.

26.question_text_en: Q.7 Fill in the blank: Article ____ explicitly states that courts cannot question the validity of Parliamentary proceedings.
26.question_text_hi: Q.7 रिक्त स्थाान भरें: अनुच्छेेद ____ स्पष्ट रूप से कहता है कि न्यायालय संसदीय कार्यवाही की वैधता पर प्रश्न नहीं उठा सकते हैं।
26.explanation_en:
Explanation
Article 122 of the Constitution of India provides immu-
nity to parliamentary proceedings, stating that the validity
of any proceedings in Parliament cannot be called in
question on the ground of any alleged irregularity of pro-
cedure.
Important Facts:
➤ Article 122(1) prohibits courts from inquiring into
parliamentary proceedings on grounds of irregularity of
procedure.
➤ Article 122(2) shields officers and members of
Parliament from court jurisdiction regarding powers exer-
cised for regulating procedure or conducting business.
➤ Article 120 deals with the language to be used
in Parliament (Hindi or English).
➤ Article 121 restricts discussions in Parliament re-
garding the conduct of judges of the Supreme Court or
High Courts.
➤ Article 123 empowers the President to pro-
mulgate Ordinances during the recess of
Parliament.
✔ Answer: (C)

27.question_text_en: Q.8 The schedule which deals with anti-defection provisions is:
27.question_text_hi: Q.8 दलबदल विरोधी प्रावधानों से संबंधित अनुसूची कौन सी है:
27.explanation_en:
Explanation
The Tenth Schedule of the Indian Constitution con-
tains the anti-defection law, which lays down the
provisions regarding the disqualification of members of
Parliament and State Legislatures on grounds of defec-
tion.
Important Facts:
➤ The Tenth Schedule was added to the Constitution by
the 52nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1985.
➤ The law was enacted during the prime ministership of
Rajiv Gandhi to curb political opportunism.
➤ The question of disqualification under the Tenth
Schedule is decided by the Chairman or Speaker of
the respective House.
➤ The Supreme Court ruled in the landmark Kihoto
Hollohan case (1992) that the Speaker's decision is
subject to judicial review.
➤ The 91st Constitutional Amendment Act,
2003 omitted the provision protecting one-third splits
and limited the size of the Council of Ministers to 15% of
the lower house.
✔ Answer: (C)
27.explanation_hi:
Explanation
भारतीय संविधान की दसवीं अनुसूची में दलबदल विरोधी कानून
शामिल है, जो दलबदल के आधार पर संसद और राज्य विधानमंड-
लों के सदस्यों की अयोग्यता से संबंधित प्रावधान तय करता है।
महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य:
➤ दसवीं अनुसूची को 52वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम,
1985 द्वाारा संविधान में जोड़ाा गया था।
➤ यह कानून राजनीतिक अस्थि
रता रोकने के लिए प्रधानमंत्री रा-
जीव गांधी के कार्यकाल में पारित किया गया था।
➤ दसवीं अनुसूची के तहत अयोग्यता के प्रश्न का निर्णय संबंधित
सदन के सभापति या अध्यक्ष द्वाारा किया जाता है।
➤ उच्चतम न्यायालय ने ऐतिहासिक किहोतो होलोहन मामले
(1992) में निर्णय दिया कि अध्यक्ष का निर्णय न्यायिक समीक्षा के
अधीन है।
➤ 91वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 2003 ने एक-तिहाई
सदस्यों के विभाजन के संरक्षण प्रावधान को समाप्त कर दिया और
मंत्रिपरिषद का आकार निचले सदन के 15% तक सीमित कर
दिया।
✔ Answer: (C)

28.question_text_en: Q.9 The Parliament can create a new all-India service under:
28.question_text_hi: Q.9 संसद किसके अंतर्गत एक नई अखिल भारतीय सेवा का सृजन कर सकती है:
28.explanation_en:
Explanation
Under Article 312 of the Constitution of India,
Parliament is empowered to create one or more new
All-India Services (including an all-India judicial ser-
vice) common to the Union and the States, provided the
Rajya Sabha passes a resolution supported by not
less than two-thirds of the members present and voting.
Important Facts:
➤ The creation of a new All-India Service requires an
initial resolution by the Rajya Sabha declaring it nec-
essary or expedient in the national interest.
➤ Currently, there are three All-India Services in India:
the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), the
Indian Police Service (IPS), and the Indian
Forest Service (IFS).
➤ The Indian Forest Service was created as the
third All-India Service in 1966 under the All India
Services Act, 1951.
➤ Article 249 empowers Parliament to legislate on a
State List subject in the national interest upon a Rajya
Sabha resolution.
➤ Article 315 deals with the Public Service
Commissions for the Union and for the States (UPSC
and SPSCs).
✔ Answer: (B)

31.question_text_en: Q.2 Which process explains the gradual wearing away of Earth's surface due to natural forces like wind, water and ice over time?

31.explanation_en:
Explanation
Erosion is the exogenic geological process involving
the wearing away, detachment, and transportation of
weathered rock material and soil across the Earth's sur-
face by geomorphic agents such as running water,
glaciers, wind, and waves.
Important Facts:
➤ Weathering refers to the in-situ breakdown of
rocks, while erosion involves the dynamic transport of
that debris.
➤ Running water is the predominant agent of erosion in
humid regions, creating landforms like gorges,
canyons, and V-shaped valleys.
➤ Glacial erosion creates features like cirques,
aretes, and U-shaped valleys.
➤ Wind erosion in arid landscapes leads to landforms
such as mushroom rocks and yardangs.
➤ The combined process of weathering, mass wasting,
and erosion lowering the land surface is termed de-
nudation.
✔ Answer: (A)

32.question_text_en: Q.4 What is the reason that different regions on Earth experience varying climates despite receiving energy from the same Sun?
32.question_text_hi: Q.4 समान सूर्य से ऊर्जा प्राप्त करने के बावजूद पृथ्वीी के विभिन्न क्षेत्रों में अलग-अलग जलवायु का अनुभव होने का क्याा कारण है?

32.explanation_en:
Explanation
Due to Earth's spherical shape and the tilt of its axis, the
angle of incidence of sunlight varies with latitude.
Areas near the equator receive direct, perpendicular
rays concentrating solar energy, while higher latitudes
receive oblique rays spread over larger areas.
Important Facts:
➤ The angle at which solar radiation strikes the Earth's
surface determines the intensity of insolation.
➤ The Earth's axial tilt of 23.5 degrees combined
with revolution causes seasonal climatic variations.
➤ Oblique rays at higher latitudes pass through a
thicker layer of atmosphere, losing more energy through
absorption and scattering.
➤ The equatorial region experiences a net heat sur-
plus, whereas polar regions experience a net heat
deficit.
➤ Atmospheric circulation and ocean currents act as
heat redistribution mechanisms across different
latitudes.
✔ Answer: (B)

33.question_text_en: Q.14 The term "Jhumming" is specifically associated with which type of agricultural practice in India?
33.question_text_hi: Q.14 "झूमिंंग" (Jhumming) शब्द भारत में विशेष रूप से किस प्रकार की कृषि पद्धति से संबंधित है?

options.text_en: Slash-and-burn shifting cultivation in North-Eastern India

33.explanation_en:
Explanation
In India, Jhumming is the local name for slash-and-
burn shifting cultivation primarily practiced in the
hill tracts of North-Eastern India (such as Assam,
Meghalaya, Nagaland, and Mizoram).
Important Facts:
➤ In this method, farmers clear a patch of forest land by
cutting and burning vegetation, and cultivate crops on
the ash-enriched soil for a few seasons before moving.
➤ Shifting cultivation is known by various regional
names in India: Bewar or Dahiya in Madhya Pradesh,
Podu or Penda in Andhra Pradesh.
➤ In Odisha, it is known as Koman or Bringa, and in
the Western Ghats, it is called Kumari.
➤ Globally, shifting cultivation is known as Milpa in
Mexico/Central America, Roca in Brazil, and Ladang
in Indonesia.
➤ The practice has faced restrictions due to soil ero-
sion, deforestation, and reduced fallow cycle lengths.
✔ Answer: (C)

34.question_text_en: Q.7 In the case of the housefly (Musca domestica), what is its taxonomic 'Order'?
34.question_text_hi: Q.7 घरेलू मक्खीी (मस्का डोमेस्टि का) के मामले में, इसका टैक्सोनोमिक 'ऑर्डर' (गण) क्याा है?
34.explanation_en:
Explanation
The taxonomic order of the housefly (*Musca domes-
tica*) is Diptera. Insects in the order Diptera are char-
acterised by possessing only a single pair of functional
flight wings, with the hindwings modified into balancing
organs called halteres.
Important Facts:
➤ The complete taxonomic hierarchy of the housefly is:
Phylum Arthropoda, Class Insecta, Order Diptera,
Family Muscidae, Genus Musca, Species domes-
tica.
➤ 'Diptera' is derived from Greek words meaning 'two
wings'.
➤ The hind pair of wings in Diptera is modified into sen-
sory structures called halteres for gyroscopic balance
during flight.
➤ Houseflies possess sponging and lapping type
mouthparts adapted for liquid nutrition.
➤ They serve as vectors for pathogenic diseases in-
cluding cholera, typhoid, and dysentery.
✔ Answer: (C)

35.explanation_en:

Space technology, including Earth observation satellites
and meteorological constellations, provides real-
time monitoring and broad synoptic coverage, en-
abling early warnings, damage assessment, and prompt
decision-making during natural disasters.
Important Facts:
➤ Remote sensing satellites provide continuous, multi-
spectral data for tracking cyclones, floods, droughts, and
forest fires.
➤ Communication satellites ensure vital connectivity
when terrestrial communication networks collapse during
disasters.
➤ Navigation satellites like NavIC and GPS help guide
search and rescue operations to precise coordinates.
➤ India's National Remote Sensing Centre
(NRSC) under ISRO plays a central role in generating
near-real-time flood and cyclone maps.
➤ Space imagery enables accurate pre-disaster vulner-
ability mapping as well as post-disaster loss estimation.
✔ Answer: (B)

Summit (United Nations Conference on Environment
and Development), is a comprehensive action plan re-
flecting a global commitment to integrate envi-
ronmental protection with sustainable socio-
economic development.
Important Facts:
➤ The Rio Earth Summit was held in Rio de Janeiro,
Brazil, in June 1992.
➤ 'Agenda 21' signifies a blueprint for sustainable de-
velopment in the 21st century.
➤ The summit also led to the creation of the UNFCCC,
CBD (Convention on Biological Diversity), and the Rio
Declaration.
➤ It emphasizes Local Agenda 21, urging local gov-
ernments to implement sustainable policies at the grass-
roots level.
➤ The summit popularized the principle of Common
But Differentiated Responsibilities (CBDR).

40.explanation_en:
Explanation
The PM-SETU scheme was approved and rolled out in
2025 by the Government of India to comprehensively
revamp and modernize 1,000 Government
Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) across the
country into world-class skill training hubs.
Important Facts:
➤ The full form of PM-SETU is Pradhan Mantri
Skilling and Employability Transformation
through Upgraded ITIs.
➤ The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of
Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
(MSDE).
➤ It adopts a Hub-and-Spoke model, designating
200 Hub ITIs and 800 Spoke ITIs across states.
➤ It introduces an industry-led Special Purpose
Vehicle (SPV) governance structure under Section 8
of the Companies Act.
➤ The scheme aligns vocational training with emerging
industry requirements such as Industry 4.0, green skills,
and advanced automation.
✔ Answer: (D)

Right option (C): 7
Explanation
In each row, the third number is the sum of the squares
of the first two numbers (a² + b² = c):

• Row 3: 9² + 12² = 81 + 144 = 225.

• पंक्ति
 2: 6² + 8² = 36 + 64 = 100।
• पंक्ति
 3: 9² + 12² = 81 + 144 = 225।
• पंक्ति
 1: ?² + 5² = 74 ⇒ ?² = 74 − 25 = 49 ⇒ ? = 7।

20.question_text_en: In a non-leap year, if 1 January is Wednesday, how many Mondays will occur in February and March together?
20.question_text_hi: In a non-leap year, if 1 January is Wednesday, how many Mondays will occur in February and March together?
20.explanation_en:
Q.10
Right option (B): 9
Explanation
In a non-leap year, January has 31 days (3 odd days).
If 1 January is Wednesday, then 1 February =
Wednesday + 3 = Saturday.
Thus, the first Monday of February is 3 February.
Total days in Feb (28) + March (31) = 59 days.
Mondays occur on days 3, 10, 17, 24, 31, 38, 45, 52,
and 59 (i.e., 4 in Feb and 5 in March) = 9 Mondays.
✔ Answer: (B)

खेल के रूप में शामिल किया गया था।
➤ भारत में कबड्डी की सर्वोच्च नियामक संस्था एमेच्योोर कबड्डी
फेडरेशन ऑफ इंडिया (AKFI) है।
✔ Answer: (C)

Gold, Silver, and Bronze medals to the competi-

➤ The first edition of the Asian Games was held in
New Delhi in 1951.
➤ The Asian Games are organized every four years by
the Olympic Council of Asia (OCA).
➤ The emblem of the Asian Games features a rising
red sun with interlocking rings.
➤ The 19th Asian Games were held in Hangzhou,

29.question_text_en: Q.10 What is the name of the distinctive stiff skirt used in Manipuri classical dance?
29.question_text_hi: Q.10 मणिपुरी शास्त्रीय नृत्य में प्रयुक्त होने वाले विशिष्ट कठोर स्कर्ट का नाम क्याा है?
29.explanation_en:
Explanation
In Manipuri classical dance (specifically in Raas
Leela), female dancers wear an iconic, barrel-shaped
stiff skirt called Poloi (or Potloi). It is embellished with
mirrors, embroidery, and stiffened canvas to maintain its
distinct cylindrical flare.
Important Facts:
➤ Potloi (or Poloi) costume was introduced during the
reign of King Bhagyachandra (Maharaja Ningthou
Ching-Thang Khomba).
➤ Raas Leela depicts the divine love of Radha and
Krishna and forms the central theme of Manipuri
dance.
➤ A translucent white veil called Koktombi is worn
over the head covering the face partially.
➤ Phanek is a traditional wraparound sarong worn by
Meitei women for daily and semi-formal wear.
➤ Manipuri is one of the major eight classical dances
recognized by the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
✔ Answer: (C)
29.explanation_hi:
Explanation
मणिपुरी शास्त्रीय नृत्य (विशेष रूप से रासलीला) में नर्तकियों द्वाारा
पहनी जाने वाली विशिष्ट, बेलनाकार और कठोर स्कर्ट को पोलोई
(या पोटलोई) कहा जाता है। इसके विशिष्ट आकार को बनाए रखने
के लिए इसमें कड़ेे कैनवास, दर्पण और कशीदाकारी का उपयोग
किया जाता है।
महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य:
➤ पोटलोई (पोलोई) वेशभूषा की शुरुआत राजा भाग्यचंद्र (महा-
राजा निंंगथौ चिंंग-थांग खोंबा) के शासनकाल के दौरान हुई थी।
➤ रासलीला राधा और कृष्ण के दिव्य प्रेम को दर्शाती है और
मणिपुरी नृत्य का मुख्य आधार है।
➤ सिर पर कोकतोम्बी नामक एक पारदर्शी सफेद घूंघट पहना
जाता है।
➤ फनेक मैतेई महिलाओं द्वाारा दैनिक जीवन में पहना जाने वाला
पारंपरिक वस्त्र (लहंगा/सरोंग) है।
➤ मणिपुरी, संगीत नाटक अकादमी द्वाारा मान्यता प्राप्त आठ प्र-
मुख शास्त्रीय नृत्यों में से एक है।
✔ Answer: (C)

30.explanation_hi:
Explanation
शंघाई सहयोग संगठन (SCO) की स्थापना 15 जून 2001 को

का नाम बदलकर शंघाई सहयोग संगठन (SCO) किया गया।
➤ भारत और पाकिस्तान जून 2017 में अस्ताना शिखर सम्मेलन

कारी समिति का मुख्यालय ताशकंद, उज्बेेकिस्तान में स्थि
त है।
✔ Answer: (B)

31.question_text_en: Q.4 PM-AASHA stands for:
31.question_text_hi: Q.4 PM-AASHA का पूर्ण रूप क्याा है?

options.text_en: Pradhan Mantri Aatma-Nirbhar Aay Sahayata Abhiyan
Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan
Pradhan Mantri Annadata Awas Suraksha Abhiyan
Pradhan Mantri Agricultural Aay Samridhi Abhiyan

31.explanation_en:
Explanation
PM-AASHA stands for Pradhan Mantri Annadata
Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan, an umbrella scheme
launched by the Government of India in 2018 to ensure
remunerative prices to farmers for their produce.
Important Facts:
➤ The scheme was approved by the Union Cabinet in
September 2018.
➤ PM-AASHA comprises three key sub-components:
Price Support Scheme (PSS), Price Deficiency
Payment Scheme (PDPS), and Pilot of Private
Procurement and Stockist Scheme (PPSS).
➤ It covers pulses, oilseeds, and copra to protect farm-
ers against steep price falls below the Minimum Support
Price (MSP).
➤ Under PDPS, no physical procurement takes place;
farmers receive direct payment of the difference be-
tween MSP and the modal market price.
➤ The scheme is implemented under the Ministry of
Agriculture and Farmers Welfare.
✔ Answer: (B)
31.explanation_hi:
Explanation
PM-AASHA का पूर्ण रूप प्रधानमंत्री अन्नदाता आय संरक्षण
अभियान (Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan
Abhiyan) है, जिसे किसानों को उनकी उपज के लिए लाभकारी मू-
ल्य सुनिश्चित करने हेतु 2018 में शुरू किया गया था।
महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य:
➤ इस योजना को केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल द्वाारा सितंबर 2018 में मंजूरी
दी गई थी।
➤ PM-AASHA के तीन प्रमुख घटक हैं: मूल्य समर्थन योजना
(PSS), मूल्य न्यूनता भुगतान योजना (PDPS), और निजी
खरीद एवं स्टॉकिस्ट पायलट योजना (PPSS)।
➤ यह मुख्य रूप से दलहन, तिलहन और खोपरा (नारियल) के
लिए न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य (MSP) सुनिश्चित करने पर केंद्रित है।
➤ PDPS के तहत फसलों की भौतिक खरीद नहीं की जाती,
बल्कि
 MSP और बाजार मूल्य के अंतर की भरपाई सीधे किसान के
बैंक खाते में की जाती है।
➤ यह योजना कृषि एवं किसान कल्याण मंत्रालय के अंतर्गत सं-
चालित की जाती है।
✔ Answer: (B)

32.question_text_en: Q.5 Which organisation is responsible for pension payout under Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM)?
32.question_text_hi: Q.5 प्रधानमंत्री श्रम योगी मानधन (PM-SYM) योजना के तहत पेंशन भुगतान के लिए कौन सा संगठन जिम्मेदार है?

options.text_en: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
options.text_hi: राष्ट्रीीय कृषि और ग्रामीण विकास बैंक

32.explanation_en:
Explanation
The Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)
acts as the pension fund manager responsible for fund
management and the monthly pension payout under the
Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-
SYM) scheme.
Important Facts:
➤ PM-SYM is a central sector scheme launched in
2019 by the Ministry of Labour and Employment for un-
organised workers.
➤ Beneficiaries receive an assured monthly pension of
Rs3,000 upon reaching the age of 60 years.
➤ The entry age for the scheme is between 18 and 40
years, with a monthly contribution ranging from Rs55 to
Rs200.
➤ The Central Government makes a matching 50:50
contribution equal to the subscriber's monthly contri-
bution.
➤ Workers earning a monthly income of Rs15,000 or
less who are not covered under EPFO, ESIC, or NPS
are eligible.
✔ Answer: (C)
32.explanation_hi:
Explanation
भारतीय जीवन बीमा निगम (LIC) पेंशन फंड मैनेजर के रूप में
कार्य करता है और प्रधानमंत्री श्रम योगी मानधन (PM-SYM)
योजना के तहत फंड प्रबंधन और मासिक पेंशन वितरण के लिए
उत्तरदायी है।
महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य:
➤ PM-SYM असंगठित क्षेत्र के कामगारों के लिए श्रम और रोज-
गार मंत्रालय द्वाारा 2019 में शुरू की गई एक केंद्रीय क्षेत्र की यो-
जना है।
➤ इसके तहत लाभार्थियों को 60 वर्ष की आयु प्राप्त करने के बाद
Rs3,000 की निश्चित मासिक पेंशन मिलती है।
➤ योजना में प्रवेश की आयु 18 से 40 वर्ष है, जिसमें मासिक अं-
शदान Rs55 से Rs200 तक होता है।
➤ केंद्र सरकार लाभार्थी के योगदान के बराबर ही 50:50 के
अनुपात में अंशदान देती है।
➤ इस योजना के लिए वे असंगठित कामगार पात्र हैं जिनकी मा-
सिक आय Rs15,000 या उससे कम है और जो EPFO, ESIC
या NPS के सदस्य नहीं हैं।
✔ Answer: (C)

34.question_text_en: Q.10 Tax reforms include:
34.question_text_hi: Q.10 कर सुधारों (टैक्स रिफॉर्म्स) में शामिल है:
34.explanation_en:
Explanation
The primary goals of tax reforms are simplifying
the tax system, rationalizing tax slabs, reducing com-
pliance burdens, curbing tax evasion, and widening the
tax base to ensure efficient revenue collection.
Important Facts:
➤ The Tax Reforms Committee (1991) under the
chairmanship of Raja J. Chelliah laid the foundational
roadmap for modern tax rationalization in India.
➤ In 2017, the Goods and Services Tax (GST)
was introduced via the 101st Constitutional
Amendment Act to simplify indirect taxation under
"One Nation, One Tax".
➤ Direct tax reforms focus on lowering corporate and
personal income tax rates while phasing out distortionary
exemptions.
➤ The Kelkar Task Force (2002) recommended sig-
nificant structural reforms in both direct and indirect taxa-
tion.
➤ Simplifying tax procedures enhances compliance, re-
duces litigation, and encourages higher tax-to-GDP
ratios.
✔ Answer: (D)
34.explanation_hi:
Explanation
